# MEOK AI Labs — MCP Catalogue (full)

> 339 production MCP servers by MEOK AI Labs, scored on the proofof.ai 100-point rubric. EU AI Act, DORA, NIS2, CRA, agent-infra, transport, aquaculture + more. Each is pip-installable + in the Anthropic MCP registry.
